fr:mainmatter.html:p: When the manual makes a definitive statement about the behavior of geolog, if the code deviates from the manual then the code is considered to have a bug.

There may be points in the manual where as I am writing, I decide that the current behavior of geolog is inadequate. In these places, I will write down what I intend the behavior to be, and mark the sentence with todo at the end.
The geolog manual is an authoratative, conceptual, and incomplete reference document for engaged users and developers of geolog.
When the manual makes a definitive statement about the behavior of geolog, if the code deviates from the manual then the code is considered to have a bug.

There may be points in the manual where as I am writing, I decide that the current behavior of geolog is inadequate. In these places, I will write down what I intend the behavior to be, and mark the sentence with todo at the end.

The purpose of the manual is to produce understanding. The manual is not a specification, but a motivated reader could probably fill in the full details of a specification from the understanding imparted in the manual. Most importantly, a user of geolog who has carefully read the manual should not need to guess at what any particular piece of code means; the conceptual understanding laid out in this manual should be sufficient to give an unambiguous human-comprehensible semantics.
This manual (like geolog itself) is currently incomplete.
The geolog manual is not a tutorial. The geolog manual is not a place for original mathematical research. The geolog manual is not a development log.

Moreover, the geolog manual is not an advertisement. The intended audience of this manual is a reader with patience and a good amount of time, who is motivated for reasons found elsewhere to learn about geolog. There may be sections where we outline the rationale for a design decision; these should not be interpreted as claims of the superiority of this design decision, merely as a record of the thought process that went into it.
